jp: レオーネ「‥‥」

en: Leone: I...

jp: レオーネ「トウヤ‥‥ボク‥‥」

en: Touya: That's right. Besides, the only one who can decide what you are is you. You feel pain, you laugh... How are you any different from us? What kind of being you are? That doesn't matter. What do you think? What do you want to be? That's what's important. Believe in yourself. Whoever you are, whatever you are, we're on your side.
